title: WhiteMountainsQAPair
description: A single training example for the NH White Mountains hiking planning agent

meta.description: Retained for QA and stratified splitting. Stripped before training.

query_type.description: The primary intent of the user query.

experience_level.description: The implied or stated experience level of the user in this example. Used for stratified eval splits and to ensure voice variation across examples.

trail_refs.description: Trail IDs that appear in or ground the assistant response.

hazard_types_present.description: Whether this example contains weather hazard info, fall hazard info, both, or neither. Used to ensure hazard coverage is balanced across the dataset.

includes_links.description: Whether the assistant response includes authoritative links. Should be true for trail-lookup and recommendation types.

reviewed.description: Human review completed. No unreviewed record enters the training split.

review_notes.description: Optional reviewer notes on corrections made or concerns flagged.

messages.description: The full conversation in chat format. Compatible with TRL, Unsloth, and Axolotl SFT.
First item must be role=system. Second must be role=user. Third must be role=assistant. Multi-turn examples may have additional user/assistant pairs.
